frame_wall_definition: FrameExecutionStart.started_at to post-Host observation.now; App plus native Host/submit wall including waits, not CPU execution/GPU execution/scanout
gpu_completion_definition: original App frame start to queue-completion callback observation, not GPU execution/scanout

paused_cadence.caller_idle_wait_cap: remaining requested 300 ms interval on each native poll; 100 ms settles use their remaining interval; no independent 2 ms caller polling
paused_cadence.cpu_claim: raw quantized process counters only; no stable CPU or power reduction claim
paused_cadence.other_original_deadlines: first-present/READY and telemetry seal remain independent owner requests; Continue withdraws only the observer deadline

pending_gpu_maintenance.observed_facts: each interval retains latest original pending completion/resource telemetry counters and cumulative received completion sample counts before/after; telemetry counters alone do not prove native submission custody is settled
pending_gpu_maintenance.owner: original desktop presentation and WGPU Host
pending_gpu_maintenance.trigger: unsettled original submission-prefix custody, pending render result or active telemetry seal; independent of observer deadlines

paused_cadence.scope: aggregate original App frames, actual observer callbacks and native poll calls across all three 300 ms conditions per original run, both recipes; excludes settles, separate observer deadline validation and gameplay controls; actual cooperative wall spans remain in each condition

first_presentation.scope: first original actual presentation; exact App/render/window/device transaction, App frame start through post-Host observation including waits; not GPU execution or scanout; separate from running warmup and measured frames

controls.scope: after all three idle intervals and separate observer deadline validation; original Wait maintenance, one original StepFixedTick then full paused maintenance, followed by Poll Resume/Pause; excluded from running samples and cadence totals

step_and_full_maintenance.step_poll_scope: one native poll may complete the automatic full frame requested after exact Step; explicit full paused maintenance is still requested afterward

arming.scope: one original nonblocking native poll publishes the absolute observer deadline before the separate 1 s caller-capped wait; no App maintenance request

observer_deadline.cooperative_bound_definition: first original callback at or after the absolute 100 ms deadline must have observation.now within 250 ms of arming; native calls and callbacks are not interruptible, actual wall overshoot is retained rather than converted into an interval timeout error
observer_deadline.scope: separate original observer deadline control after deadline-free Wait settling; excluded from all idle aggregates and CPU samples; deadline offsets use one local Instant origin, callbacks record original observation.now, poll walls include actual native work and waits

telemetry_after.scope: latest original observer telemetry counters and cumulative uniquely received completion samples; these counters do not prove submission-prefix custody is settled

telemetry_before.scope: latest original observer telemetry counters and cumulative uniquely received completion samples; these counters do not prove submission-prefix custody is settled

paused_cadence.order_definition: Poll, periodic-observer Wait, deadline-free Wait on odd numbered runs; reverse on even numbered runs, independently of plain/witness order

poll.observer_callback_definition: every invocation of the original presentation observer, including maintenance and repeated/no presentation receipts; independent of unique presentations and native poll calls
poll.presentation_definition: unique original successful receipts validated against current App/render/device transaction; not inferred from canonical state, App frames, poll calls, or scanout
